section: Cut-out sheets at the end of the chapter (no section number printed)
belongs_to: Blank square dot-paper sheet printed on the last cut-out pages of the chapter, after the 'TANGRAM' cut-out sheet (pdf page 28); no question or example in the chapter text points to it
description: A full-page blank sheet of square dot paper: 17 dots across (columns) by 24 dots down (rows) = 408 small grey dots, all identical, evenly spaced in a square lattice with equal horizontal and vertical spacing (about 49.5 px on the page image in both directions), no lines joining the dots, no numbers, no labels, no axes. The dots cover the whole sheet except a margin; the first dot row is near the top edge and the last dot row near the bottom edge, the first column about 55 px right of a vertical dashed cut line. A vertical dashed grey cut line runs down the left edge of the page with two small scissors symbols on it, one near the top (level with the first dot row) and one near the bottom (level with the last dot row); the scissors and the dashed line are decoration, not mathematical content. A large grey diagonal watermark '(c) NCERT not to be republished' lies over the middle of the page (not part of the figure).
unclear: This is a blank drawing sheet; the chapter text does not refer to it, so it may only be listed for accounting (no item draws on it).
No section number is printed on the page; the section field is a descriptive label, not a book section.
